title: Microsoft Purview: archive SharePoint files from retention policies
summary: Hold: the retention-policy route stops before required wizard choices and the archive setting, and the billing route omits the connection toggle that enables the service. The opt-in default, E5 requirement, storage billing model and archive behaviour are supported.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy is the route to the retention-policy archive control.
claims.quote: For the Choose the type of retention policy to create page, select Adaptive or Static ... For Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both page, specify the configuration options
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the table with 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations > SharePoint sites > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both > Archive retained items in secure and compliant Microsoft 365 Archive to reduce cost'. Set its docs URL to https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-settings#archiving-retained-sharepoint-files, which documents the archive setting itself; retain the already cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies for the wizard route.

claims.claim: Automation for selecting the retention-policy archive action is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'New-RetentionComplianceRule Set-RetentionComplianceRule archive action SharePoint parameters'; opened both cmdlet references and retention settings. Neither rule reference has an archive parameter; RetentionComplianceAction lists Delete, Keep and KeepAndDelete.

claims.claim: Billing > Pay-as-you-go > Services > Microsoft 365 Archive > Connect a policy reaches the control that connects Archive billing.
claims.quote: Select Connect a policy, turn on the Connection status toggle for the billing policy, and then select Save.
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the table with 'Billing > Pay-as-you-go > Services > Microsoft 365 Archive > Connect a policy > Connection status'. The cited setup page requires turning on Connection status for the chosen policy; opening Connect a policy alone does not connect it.

claims.claim: An API or script for connecting Microsoft 365 Archive to a pay-as-you-go billing policy is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft 365 Archive connect pay-as-you-go billing policy REST API PowerShell' and 'Microsoft Graph Microsoft 365 Archive connect billing policy API'; read Archive setup. Results document UI connection, HVE billing or unrelated Graph metered APIs, not Archive connection.

claims.claim: An admin UI for the tenant setting that hides manual file archiving independently of policy archiving is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint admin center manual file archive AllowFileArchive setting UI'; read Archive manage and Archive FAQ excerpts. Both describe PowerShell for tenant and site manual-archive controls, not an admin UI for this setting.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls prose
claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -AllowFileArchive $false hides manual Archive actions tenant-wide while allowing admin-defined policies to archive eligible files.
claims.quote: Set-SPOTenant -AllowFileArchive $false ... This tenant setting overrides the site-level property with the same name and blocks manual file archiving across the tenant. Admin-defined policies can still archive eligible files automatically.

claims.claim: SharePoint Administrators or Global Administrators control the tenant's manual file archiving setting.
claims.quote: SharePoint Administrators or Global Administrators can control manual file archiving for all SharePoint sites, a subset of sites, or not at all.

claims.claim: Audit > Search in the Microsoft Purview portal reaches audit search.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal. Select the Audit solution card. ... On the Search page, configure the following search criteria as applicable

claims.claim: Search-UnifiedAuditLog -Operations FileArchived filters audit records to the archived-file operation.
claims.quote: The Operations parameter filters the log entries by operation. The available values for this parameter depend on the RecordType value. For a list of the available values for this parameter, see Audited activities.

claims.claim: Searching the audit log in the Purview portal requires Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs roles.
claims.quote: You must be assigned the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs roles in the Microsoft Purview portal to search the audit log.

claims.claim: Search-UnifiedAuditLog runs in Exchange Online PowerShell.
claims.quote: The underlying cmdlet used to search the audit log is an Exchange Online cmdlet, which is Search-UnifiedAuditLog. ... You have to run this cmdlet in Exchange Online PowerShell.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -AllowFileArchive controls manual file archiving on individual sites.
claims.quote: To control which sites show the Archive action to users, use the -AllowFileArchive property of the Set-SPOSite cmdlet.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -AllowFileArchiveOnNewSitesByDefault controls manual file archiving defaults for future sites.
claims.quote: To control whether users can manually archive files on sites created in the future, use the -AllowFileArchiveOnNewSitesByDefault property of the Set-SPOTenant cmdlet.

claims.claim: Get-SPOSite exposes ArchivedFileDiskUsed to report storage consumed by archived files on a site.
claims.quote: The 'ArchivedFileDiskUsed' property of the Get-SPOSite cmdlet indicates the storage consumed by all archived files on that site in bytes.

claims.claim: Automatic file archive audit events provide policy identification for determining which policy archived a file.
claims.quote: When an automatic file archive policy archives a file, the event includes the policy ID, policy version, and the file's last access date.

claims.claim: The retention settings page states an E5 requirement without specifying which users or sites must hold that licence.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft 365 Archive retention E5 license which users sites unsupported file types'; read retention settings archive section. It states 'File-level archive requires a Microsoft 365 E5 license' without assignment details; the general service description gives beneficiary rules.

claims.claim: The retention settings page says unsupported items remain active but does not list their types.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft 365 Archive retention E5 license which users sites unsupported file types'; read retention settings archive section. It does not enumerate types. Archive overview separately lists general file-archive limitations; this claim is limited to the retention settings page.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist recommends setting optional budgets and alerts without a controls-table entry for that setting.
claims.quote: with a budget and alerts if wanted. ... Controls: retention-policy archiving; connection to a billing policy; manual file archiving; audit records.
claims.fix: Remove ', with a budget and alerts if wanted' from the Before rollout checklist step. The supported budget discussion can remain in Cost and licensing; no new control row is required.
